_comment: Committed CI floors for the replay-mode regression gate (D6). PENDING RATCHET: the count-shape + honest-refusal prompt fix (prompt_version 5e599a2bc2168b8e) stales every committed real-capture fixture uniformly -> the gate downgrades to advisory (exit 0) and NO quality floor is evaluated until the human re-captures. These floors are therefore the PRE-fix calibration and are left unchanged in-PR by design; the human ratchets them post-re-capture (eval/README.md runbook step 5) to ~5pp under the newly measured rates. A bank-growth follow-up (runbook step 6) lands together with that re-capture. Prior baseline (report.json @ prompt_version f3a5ad27, 60 cases): T2_semantic_valid 1.00 (36/36), T4_answer_correct 0.78 (28/36), out_of_scope_honest 0.75 (18/24); floors sit ~5pp under with headroom for temperature=0 re-capture jitter (1 in-scope case = 2.8pp). Keys: in-scope tier rates (over in-scope cases that are not stale/missing), the out-of-scope honest-refusal rate, min_fixtures (catches deletion), max_stale (partial-staleness tolerance; uniform all-stale downgrades to advisory).
